_README: Manual override table. Highest-priority signal: an entry here wins over the LLM
profile and over the volume heuristic (spec section 4, O1).
Key   = company name as it appears in the CSVs (normalised on load, so casing
and a trailing Inc/LLC/Ltd do not matter).
Value = any subset of {kind, tier, prom}; anything you omit keeps the LLM value.
kind: employer | outsourcing | staffing | training | job_board | unknown
tier: 3 household name | 2 large or well known | 1 small but real | 0 unknown
tier >= 2 lifts a company out of the long tail into the graded
segments; tier 3 + an entry-level title reaches the top segment.
prom: 0-100, orders rows INSIDE a segment. Nothing else uses it.
why:  free text, shown in the dashboard.
This is the only fix for the structural gap in section 8.1: companies founded or
spun off after the model's knowledge cutoff can never receive a tier from any
model or any batch. The seed list below is the 23 companies stage-2 could not
recover (round2 eval BB4-c). Edit freely - it is meant to be a few dozen lines.

Yara AI.why: early AI startup in a hiring burst; the volume rule misjudges it
